headline: Minister Bolat: Our 2-Year E-Export Target Is 10 Billion Dollars
summary: Trade Minister Ömer Bolat said the number of companies engaged in e-exports rose 40% over two years to 8,500, with e-export volume reaching $6 billion. The target is $10 billion within two years.
why: E-exports are cross-border online sales of goods and services, and government targets signal support for trade growth and competitiveness of exporters.
